```{ojs}
data = FileAttachment("dashboard/data.json").json()
k = data.kpis
fmt = (n) => (n == null ? "—" : n.toLocaleString("en-US"))
fmtP = (p) => (p == null ? "—" : p < 1e-3 ? p.toExponential(1) : p.toFixed(3))
phen = (id) => data.vocab.phenotype_labels[id] ?? id
stress = (id) => data.vocab.stressor_labels[id] ?? id
TIER = new Map([["high_priority_cross_study", "High priority"], ["multi_omics_convergence", "Multi-omics"], ["metabolite_linked_convergence", "Metabolite-linked"], ["emerging", "Emerging"]])
clip = (v, n) => (v && v.length > n ? htl.html`<span title="${v}">${v.slice(0, n - 1).trimEnd()}…</span>` : v ?? "")
// "Calla B, Thompson NF, Burge CA (2026)" -> "Calla et al. (2026)"
shortCite = (c) => {
  const m = (c ?? "").match(/^([^,(]+?)\s+[A-Z]{1,3}\b.*?(\(\d{4}[a-z]?\))/);
  if (!m) return c ?? "";
  const nAuthors = c.slice(0, c.indexOf(m[2])).split(",").length;
  return `${m[1]}${nAuthors > 2 ? " et al." : nAuthors === 2 ? " and coauthor" : ""} ${m[2]}`;
}
// ["Disease resistance", "Disease susceptibility"] -> "Disease resistance / susceptibility"
joinLabels = (labels) => {
  if (labels.length < 2) return labels.join("");
  const first = labels[0].split(" ")[0];
  return labels.every(l => l.startsWith(first + " "))
    ? `${first} ${labels.map(l => l.slice(first.length + 1).toLowerCase()).join(" / ")}`
    : labels.join(" / ");
}
missing = Object.entries(data.artifacts_present).filter(([, v]) => !v).map(([n]) => n)
```

```{ojs}
builtDate = data.generated_at?.slice(0, 10) ?? data.commit.date
```

  AREE turns public oyster omics datasets into comparable resilience-biomarker evidence

${missing.length ? html`<p><strong>Pipeline outputs missing from this build:</strong> ${missing.join(", ")}. Counts that depend on them read as zero.</p>` : ""}`

## What the evidence says so far

```{ojs}
{
  // Every sentence below is computed from data.json, so it stays current as studies are added.
  const ASSAY = {rnaseq: "RNA-seq", methylation: "methylation", proteomics: "proteomics", metabolomics: "metabolomics"};
  const assay = (a) => ASSAY[a] ?? a;
  const list = (xs) => xs.length < 2 ? xs.join("") : `${xs.slice(0, -1).join(", ")} and ${xs[xs.length - 1]}`;
  // Lower-case a label mid-sentence, leaving acronyms like "pH" alone.
  const lc = (s) => s.split(" ").map(w => w.length > 1 && w[1] === w[1].toLowerCase() ? w[0].toLowerCase() + w.slice(1) : w).join(" ");
  const relevance = (id) => data.vocab.phenotype_resilience_relevance?.[id];

  const real = data.studies.filter(s => !s.simulated);
  const withEvidence = real.filter(s => s.n_evidence_records > 0);
  const assaysRegistered = [...new Set(real.flatMap(s => s.assay_types))];
  const assaysWithEvidence = new Set(withEvidence.flatMap(s => s.assay_types));
  const awaiting = real.filter(s => s.n_evidence_records === 0 && s.qc_status !== "failed"
                                    && s.assay_types.some(a => !assaysWithEvidence.has(a)));
  const failed = real.filter(s => s.qc_status === "failed");

  const pools = data.pools.filter(p => !p.simulated && p.feature_type === "gene");
  const cross = pools.filter(p => p.max_k >= 2).sort((a, b) => b.studies.length - a.studies.length);
  const single = pools.filter(p => p.max_k < 2);

  const classes = data.candidates.by_evidence_class.filter(d => !d.simulated).sort((a, b) => b.n - a.n);
  const nRanked = classes.reduce((s, d) => s + d.n, 0);
  const top = data.candidates.top_real;
  const topPhens = [...new Set(top.map(r => r.phenotype))];

  const coverage = html`<p>${real.length} real studies cover ${k.n_real_stressor_classes} stressor
    ${k.n_real_stressor_classes === 1 ? "class" : "classes"}
    (${list(k.real_stressor_classes.map(s => lc(stress(s))))}) and
    ${list(assaysRegistered.map(assay))} assays. ${withEvidence.length
      ? `${withEvidence.length} of them have harmonized evidence (${k.n_comparisons_real_harmonized} of
         ${k.n_comparisons_real} comparisons), ${assaysWithEvidence.size === 1 ? "all" : "spanning"}
         ${list([...assaysWithEvidence].map(assay))}.`
      : "None has harmonized evidence yet."}</p>`;

  const poolItems = cross.map(p => html`<li><strong>${phen(p.phenotype)}</strong>, <em>${p.species}</em>
    (${p.studies.length} studies: ${p.studies.join(", ")}): ${fmt(p.n_features_k2plus)} genes measured in at
    least two studies, ${fmt(p.n_features_k2plus_significant)} with a pooled effect significant after
    multiple-testing correction.</li>`);
  const poolBlock = cross.length
    ? html`<p>Cross-study pools, where the same gene can be compared between independent studies:</p><ul>${poolItems}</ul>`
    : html`<p>No cross-study pool has formed yet; every phenotype is supported by a single study.</p>`;
  const singleText = single.length
    ? html`<p>${list(single.map((p, i) => `${i ? lc(phen(p.phenotype)) : phen(p.phenotype)} in ${p.species}`))} ${single.length === 1 ? "has" : "have"} evidence from one
      study only (${list(single.flatMap(p => p.studies))}), so ${single.length === 1 ? "its" : "their"} genes stay
      <em>emerging</em> until a second study replicates them.</p>`
    : "";

  const tierText = html`<p>${fmt(nRanked)} gene × phenotype candidates are ranked:
    ${fmt(k.n_candidates_real_high_priority)} high priority (replicated across studies),
    ${fmt(k.n_candidates_real_multi_omics)} multi-omics, ${fmt(k.n_candidates_real_metabolite_linked)} metabolite-linked,
    ${fmt(k.n_candidates_real_emerging)} emerging.
    By evidence class: ${classes.map(d => `${fmt(d.n)} ${d.evidence_class.replace(/_/g, " ")}`).join(", ")}.</p>`;

  const caveats = [];
  caveats.push(`${k.n_real_comparisons_with_resilience_phenotype} of ${k.n_comparisons_real} real comparisons
    measure a resilience outcome; the rest measure disease, stress response, or exposure alone.`);
  if (topPhens.length === 1 && relevance(topPhens[0]) !== "resilience")
    caveats.push(`The top-ranked candidates all come from the <em>${lc(phen(topPhens[0]))}</em> pool, so they describe the response to ${relevance(topPhens[0]) === "disease" ? "infection" : "the stressor"},
      not resistance to it; each pool's own top candidates are listed below.`);
  if (k.n_candidates_real_multi_omics === 0)
    caveats.push(`The multi-omics tier is empty because no non-RNA-seq study has been harmonized yet.`);
  caveats.push(`A candidate here is an association across the available evidence, not a validated biomarker.`);

  const next = [];
  if (awaiting.length)
    next.push(`harmonize the registered ${list([...new Set(awaiting.flatMap(s => s.assay_types)
      .filter(a => !assaysWithEvidence.has(a)))].map(assay))} studies (${awaiting.map(s => s.study_id).join(", ")})
      to open the multi-omics tier`);
  if (single.length)
    next.push(`find a second study for ${list(single.map(p => `${lc(phen(p.phenotype))} in ${p.species}`))}`);
  if (failed.length)
    next.push(`resolve the QC failures in ${failed.map(s => s.study_id).join(", ")}`);

  return html`${coverage}${poolBlock}${singleText}${tierText}
    ${Object.assign(document.createElement("p"), {innerHTML: caveats.join(" ")})}
    ${next.length ? html`<p>Next curation steps: ${list(next)}
      (<a href="candidate_studies.html">candidate studies</a>).</p>` : ""}`;
}
```

### Top candidates

```{ojs}
realStudies = data.studies.filter(s => !s.simulated)
// A column whose value is the same in every row is stated once above its table instead.
single = (rows, f) => { const vals = new Set(rows.map(f)); return vals.size === 1 ? [...vals][0] : null; }
topPhen = single(data.candidates.top_real, r => r.phenotype_label)
studyStress = single(realStudies, s => s.stressors.map(stress).join(", "))
```

```{ojs}
html`<p>Ranked by tier, then score${topPhen ? html`, all for <em>${topPhen}</em>` : ""}.
  Click a gene to open its evidence card; hover a description to see it in full.</p>`
```

```{ojs}
candidateTable = (rows, {showPhenotype = false, maxRows = 15} = {}) => Inputs.table(rows, {
  columns: ["feature_id_standardized", "gene_description", ...(showPhenotype ? ["phenotype_label"] : []),
            "tier", "k_studies", "pooled_effect", "adjusted_p_value"],
  header: {feature_id_standardized: "Gene", gene_description: "Description", phenotype_label: "Phenotype",
           tier: "Tier", k_studies: "Studies", pooled_effect: "log2FC", adjusted_p_value: "Adj. p"},
  format: {
    feature_id_standardized: (v, i, rows) => rows[i].card_page ? htl.html`<a href="${rows[i].card_page}">${v}</a>` : v,
    gene_description: v => clip(v, 38),
    tier: v => TIER.get(v) ?? v,
    pooled_effect: v => (v == null ? "—" : v.toFixed(2)),
    adjusted_p_value: fmtP
  },
  rows: maxRows, layout: "auto"
})
```

```{ojs}
candidateTable(data.candidates.top_real, {showPhenotype: !topPhen})
```

### Top candidates per pool

```{ojs}
{
  // The overall list above is dominated by the pool with the most studies, so each
  // cross-study pool also shows its own best candidates.
  const byPhen = data.candidates.top_real_by_phenotype ?? {};
  // Pools are per species; a phenotype pooled in several species gets one section.
  const byKey = new Map();
  for (const p of data.pools.filter(p => !p.simulated && p.feature_type === "gene" && p.max_k >= 2
                                         && byPhen[p.phenotype]?.length)) {
    const m = byKey.get(p.phenotype) ?? {phenotype: p.phenotype, studies: [], species: []};
    m.studies.push(...p.studies); m.species.push(p.species);
    byKey.set(p.phenotype, m);
  }
  const pools = [...byKey.values()]
    .sort((a, b) => b.studies.length - a.studies.length || a.phenotype.localeCompare(b.phenotype));
  if (!pools.length) return html`<p>No cross-study pool has ranked candidates yet.</p>`;
  // A pool whose list is exactly the head of the overall table gets a pointer, not a repeat.
  const key = (r) => `${r.phenotype}|${r.feature_id_standardized}`;
  const overallHead = (rows) => rows.every((r, i) => key(r) === key(data.candidates.top_real[i] ?? {}));
  return html`${pools.map(p => {
    const rows = byPhen[p.phenotype];
    return html`
    <h4>${phen(p.phenotype)}</h4>
    <p class="dash-meta">${p.studies.length} studies (${p.studies.join(", ")})${p.species.length > 1 ? html`, ${p.species.length} species, each ranked within its own species` : ""}; top ${rows.length}
      by tier, then score${overallHead(rows) ? `: the same as the first ${rows.length} rows of the overall table above.` : "."}</p>
    ${overallHead(rows) ? "" : candidateTable(rows, {maxRows: rows.length})}`;
  })}`;
}
```

## Across species

```{ojs}
{
  // WP6 gate: pooled cross-species results appear only for a phenotype where at
  // least two species each have a within-species pool with k >= 2. Before that
  // the page offers only the ortholog lookup below.
  const xs = data.cross_species ?? {gate: [], top_real: [], withheld: []};
  const gate = xs.gate.filter(g => !g.simulated);
  const sp = (s) => { const [g, ...rest] = s.split(" "); return rest.length ? `${g[0]}. ${rest.join(" ")}` : s; };
  if (!gate.length) return html`<p>No phenotype has real evidence from more than one species yet, so nothing
    can be compared across species. The lookup below shows where each top candidate's ortholog sits.</p>`;
  const items = gate.map(g => html`<li><strong>${phen(g.phenotype)}</strong>:
    ${g.species.map((s, i) => html`${i ? ", " : ""}<em>${sp(s.species)}</em> k = ${s.max_k}`)}.
    ${g.open ? html`Gate open: cross-species estimates shown below.`
             : html`Gate closed (${g.reason}): lookup only, no pooled estimate.`}</li>`);
  const held = xs.withheld.filter(w => !w.simulated).reduce((s, w) => s + w.n, 0);
  return html`<p>Genes are compared across species through orthogroups. A pooled cross-species estimate is shown
    for a phenotype only once at least two species each have a pool of two or more studies of their own.</p>
    <ul>${items}</ul>
    ${held ? html`<p class="dash-meta">${fmt(held)} cross-species rows for gated phenotypes are withheld.</p>` : ""}`;
}
```

```{ojs}
CROSS_TIER = new Map([["cross_species_convergence", "Convergence"], ["cross_species_emerging", "Emerging"],
                      ["cross_species_discordant", "Discordant"], ["cross_species_unsupported", "Unsupported"]])
spShort = (s) => { const [g, ...rest] = (s ?? "").split(" "); return rest.length ? `${g[0]}. ${rest.join(" ")}` : s; }
crossRows = data.cross_species?.top_real ?? []
```

```{ojs}
{
  if (!crossRows.length) return html``;
  const exposureOnly = crossRows.filter(r => r.evidence_class === "exposure_only").length;
  return html`<p>Top cross-species rows, by tier, then score. Click an orthogroup to open its card,
    which shows each species' estimate side by side.
    ${exposureOnly === crossRows.length
      ? "Every row shown rests on exposure-only evidence in at least one species, so none is a tolerance claim."
      : `${exposureOnly} of ${crossRows.length} rows rest on exposure-only evidence in at least one species.`}</p>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
crossRows.length ? Inputs.table(crossRows, {
  columns: ["orthogroup_id", "species_genes", "phenotype_label", "tier", "pooled_effect", "adjusted_p_value",
            "i_squared_between_species"],
  header: {orthogroup_id: "Orthogroup", species_genes: "Genes (studies)", phenotype_label: "Phenotype",
           tier: "Tier", pooled_effect: "log2FC", adjusted_p_value: "Adj. p", i_squared_between_species: "I² between species"},
  format: {
    orthogroup_id: (v, i, rows) => rows[i].card_page ? htl.html`<a href="${rows[i].card_page}">${v}</a>` : v,
    species_genes: v => htl.html`${v.map((g, i) => htl.html`${i ? "; " : ""}<em>${spShort(g.species)}</em> ${g.gene} (${g.k_studies})`)}`,
    tier: v => CROSS_TIER.get(v) ?? v,
    pooled_effect: v => (v == null ? "—" : v.toFixed(2)),
    adjusted_p_value: fmtP,
    i_squared_between_species: v => (v == null ? "—" : `${v.toFixed(0)}%`)
  },
  rows: 15, layout: "auto"
}) : html``
```

### Orthologs of the top candidates

```{ojs}
{
  const rows = data.candidates.top_real.filter(r => r.orthogroup_id);
  if (!rows.length) return html`<p>No top candidate has an orthogroup yet.</p>`;
  const withOrtho = rows.filter(r => r.orthologs?.length).length;
  return html`<p>Where each top candidate's ortholog sits in other species, and whether that species tested it.
    ${withOrtho} of ${rows.length} have an ortholog with evidence in another species. This is a lookup, not a pooled estimate.</p>
    ${Inputs.table(rows, {
      columns: ["feature_id_standardized", "species", "orthogroup_id", "orthologs"],
      header: {feature_id_standardized: "Gene", species: "Species", orthogroup_id: "Orthogroup", orthologs: "Tested in other species"},
      format: {
        feature_id_standardized: (v, i, rs) => rs[i].card_page ? htl.html`<a href="${rs[i].card_page}">${v}</a>` : v,
        species: v => htl.html`<em>${spShort(v)}</em>`,
        orthologs: v => v?.length
          ? htl.html`${v.map((o, i) => htl.html`${i ? "; " : ""}<em>${spShort(o.species)}</em> ${o.genes.join(", ")}: ${o.phenotypes.map(phen).join(", ")} (${o.studies.length} ${o.studies.length === 1 ? "study" : "studies"}, ${o.n_significant_records} significant)`)}`
          : "not tested"
      },
      rows: 15, layout: "auto"
    })}`;
}
```

           n_comparisons_harmonized: "Harmonized", n_evidence_records: "Records"},
  format: {
    study_id: (v, i, rows) => htl.html`<a href="${data.repo_url}/blob/main/${rows[i].registry_file}">${v}</a>`,
    citation: (v, i, rows) => rows[i].doi ? htl.html`<a href="https://doi.org/${rows[i].doi}" title="${v}">${shortCite(v)}</a>` : shortCite(v),
    stressors: v => v.map(stress).join(", "),
    phenotypes: v => joinLabels(v.map(phen)),
    n_comparisons_harmonized: (v, i, rows) => `${v} of ${rows[i].n_comparisons}`,
    n_evidence_records: fmt
